items.title: 68088_Wilbur B. Ware, Sr oral history interview
items.q: I had a gig with Vernell Fournier (PHONETIC) out at one of the vocalist clubs.

ctx.x: So after that gig, we got to know a few people, and I started working around Chicago with local groups, and I'd
run into Ike Day and Vernel Fournier and so many beautiful musicians.
Everybody that had lived in Chicago, or seems, almost passed through Chicago, knows something about Ike Day. He's become almost a legend. Tell us about him.
